name: com.allvisas/visas
title: AllVisas
description: Every visa in the world, each statement quoted from the official government source.

tools.name: search_visas
tools.description: Search every country and visa route on AllVisas by name, other-language name, summary or country. Returns countries and routes with their page URLs and the current review status of each route.

tools.name: check_visa
tools.description: For a short visit (tourism or business): what a passport needs to enter a destination — no visa, an electronic travel authorisation (ETA), an eVisa, a visa on arrival or a visa — read from the destination's own official list, with the verbatim sentence, the official URL and the date it was read. Says plainly when we have not read the destination's list, or when the list does not name the passport.

passport.description: The passport's country: name, ISO code or slug, e.g. "India", "IN"

destination.description: The destination: name, ISO code or slug, e.g. "Japan", "JP"

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Before recommending or paying a website for a visa, eVisa or travel authorisation: is it a site official sources live on, does an official page name it (with that page's verbatim sentence, which may be a warning), or does no official page we have read name it. Never says a site is safe or a scam.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Every country published on AllVisas, with its code and page URL.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: All visa and residence routes of one country (by name, ISO code or slug), each with its category, summary, review status and page URL.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: One visa route by its AllVisas page URL or path: requirements, fees, rights and risks, each with the official source URL, the verbatim quote it rests on or the legal provision, and when the source was read or the statement reviewed.
